summary: Mayfair Gold Corp., a TSXV/NYSE American-listed Canadian gold developer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 5, 2026 news release announcing the appointment of Daniel Janusauskas, P.Eng., as Vice President, Technical Services effective November 1, 2026. This is a routine senior-management hire, not a special situation. Janusauskas, formerly Technical Services Manager at Generation Mining, will lead technical services for the 100%-owned Fenn-Gib Gold Project, which hosts a 4.3 Moz indicated resource and 1.0 Moz probable reserve, targeting a 2028 construction start and 2030 production. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated.
